title: Shadow rollout / dual-path validation for pinned model variants
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce a shadow (dark-launch) and split-eval path for validating new model revisions that are pinned to customer routes. The feature will let production traffic be duplicated to a candidate revision (no user-visible serving from candidate) while simultaneously running an isolated A/B evaluator that compares outputs and performance metrics. Goals: reduce rollout risk for pinned updates, detect quality regressions early, and collect perf profiles for publishing without exposing customers to noisy fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Control and candidate requests can be duplicated with <1% added latency for control path
A/B evaluator produces deterministic quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-similarity/custom prompts) and surface actionable diffs in Console
Perf telemetry (latency p50/p95, memory, kv-cache hit rate) for candidate revision stored under a revision-scoped profile and visible in the model catalog
Operators can enable/disable shadow mode per-route/pin and schedule sample rates (0.1% - 100%)
No candidate revision responses are returned to end users in shadow mode; fallback behavior remains unchanged
updates: 2025-09-15: Ticket created during product sync. Initial PRD drafted (link above).
2025-09-18: Engineering spike completed. Confirmed request duplication approach using sidecar router is feasible; expected network overhead ~0.6% at 1k rps.

2025-09-24: Chose evaluator approach: dual-path scoring (embedding distance + prompt-based golden test set). Discussed trade-offs: synthetic tests are fast but miss distribution drift; golden prompts are small but high signal.
2025-09-29: Eng review: must add quota guard to prevent candidate workloads from consuming unbounded GPU memory. ENG-3276 created to add per-tenant candidate caps.
2025-10-01: UX/Console mocks reviewed by Design. Action: add a status widget that surfaces divergence score with historical trend and a one-click snapshot to publish perf profile.
2025-10-02: Implementation PRs opened for runtime and console (links above). Requesting security and privacy review for copied request payloads (PII handling).
review_feedback: PM-feedback: include cost-estimate section and opt-in defaults for free-tier customers.
Design-feedback: show example diff report with qualitative examples (token-level differences) not just summary metrics.
Eng-feedback: recommend 2 modes: 'shadow-only' (no candidate compute on hot path) and 'shadow-eval' (candidate runs on same hardware for perf parity).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Candidate processing could increase GPU memory pressure -> Mitigation: enforce per-tenant caps and sample-rate limits (ENG-3276)
Risk: Duplicated requests may leak sensitive data -> Mitigation: mask PII before duplication and route to KMS-protected logs; require security sign-off
Risk: False positives from synthetic eval metrics -> Mitigation: combine signals (embeddings + golden prompts + human review for >threshold regressions)
next_steps: Finalize API contract for duplication flag and per-route sampling (PM + ENG)
Complete security review and add PII-masking library into router (due 2025-10-07)
Merge runtime PR and run staged experiment on internal traffic for one week
